name: brand-tracker-recipe
description: Raw-agency-wave to analysis-ready transformation recipe for the brand tracker. The authoritative, reproducible recipe runs against the real VelocityEngine; this contract records that reference plus a browser smoke of the analysis-ready outcome.

engineReference.notes: Executes recipe steps 1-10 (multi-dataset load, weight discovery, fuzzy variable mapping, reversed-scale remap, age_band / consideration-T2B / NPS-class recodes, weighted significance crosstabs, deck build/export/commit, session export) against the Node engine with zero manual repair. Recipe = transformLog; steps 4-7 replay on reopen (arch_07 8).

preconditions: Dev server reachable via Playwright baseURL (default: http://127.0.0.1:4173).
Engine recipe artifact reproducible via `npm run demo:brand-tracker-recipe` (exit 0).
Fixture file exists at public/examples/brandtracker_w4.sav (analysis-ready Wave 4).

steps.goal: Attach the analysis-ready Wave 4 file produced by the recipe
Confirm the analysis surface renders a weighted crosstab from the analysis-ready wave
